init.title: Real Horizon overrides
init.description:
Paste a Theodolite-app log here, or one `azimuth, elevation` pair per line, to correct PVGIS where it misses local terrain (trees, buildings, close ridges).

**Currently configured:** {n_parsed} point(s), {n_segments} interpolation segment(s) covering {covered_deg}° of horizon. Isolated points (no neighbour within max gap): {n_isolated} -- {isolated_list}.

Between two consecutive points whose azimuth gap is at most the value below, your readings linearly interpolated *replace* PVGIS. Outside any annotated arc, PVGIS is kept as-is.

data.override_log: Theodolite log or az, elev list

review.title: Review parsed overrides
review.description:
**{n_parsed}** point(s) parsed.

**{n_segments}** segment(s) will be applied, covering **{covered_deg}°** of the horizon:
{segment_list}

**{n_isolated}** isolated point(s) will be ignored: {isolated_list}.

**{n_magnetic}** reading(s) use magnetic headings. These are off by your local magnetic declination; set Theodolite to True North and re-measure if this is not 0.

Repeated readings at the same azimuth are averaged. To include isolated points, add a neighbour within the max-gap or raise the max-gap value. Click Submit to save, or close to go back without saving.

error.no_points_parsed: No (azimuth, elevation) pairs could be parsed from that text.
error.no_segments_form: All points are isolated (no two within the max-gap value). Add more points or raise the max-gap.
